scripts.dev: node scripts/build-app.mjs --dev && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && wrangler dev

ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Token the Mailflare app uses to manage your aliases. Use a long random string, for example from `openssl rand -base64 32`, and keep it: you enter it in the app to connect.

AUTH_SECRET.description: Secret that signs account sessions. Use another long random string, for example from `openssl rand -base64 32`. You never need to enter it anywhere.

DB.description: D1 database for your domains, destinations and aliases. Created automatically.
